svg.aria-label: Feature scaling changes which neighbor is closest Panel: x contribution: $s = 1$ Panel: x contribution: $s = 2$ Shared axes: x, y $s = 1$: nearest class B Raw feature x: 0 to 12 Raw feature y: 0 to 12 Class A (scatter): a A (6, 9) Class B (scatter): b B (8, 6) Query q (scatter): q q (5, 5) A: $d = \sqrt{17}$: (5, 5) → (6, 9) B: $d = \sqrt{10}$: (5, 5) → (8, 6) For $k = 1$, class B wins. Distances use $s = 1$; the plotted points stay at their original raw coordinates. $s = 2$: nearest class A Raw feature x: 0 to 12 Raw feature y: 0 to 12 Class A (scatter): a A (6, 9) Class B (scatter): b B (8, 6) Query q (scatter): q q (5, 5) A: $d = \sqrt{20}$: (5, 5) → (6, 9) B: $d = \sqrt{37}$: (5, 5) → (8, 6) For $k = 1$, class A wins. Distances use $s = 2$; the plotted points stay at their original raw coordinates. $d = \sqrt{(s\Delta x)^2 + (\Delta y)^2}$. Points and axes stay fixed; segments show raw displacements; labels show metric distances.
